clue.text: The merry monarch's rule for preparing a salad

parts.note: Old King Cole of the nursery rhyme was a merry old soul, so the merry monarch's gives his name with the possessive
a rule is a law

explanation.surface: A recipe rule laid down by a jolly king for making a salad.
explanation.walkthrough: Old King Cole is the 'merry old soul' of the nursery rhyme; his rule is Cole's law.
explanation.definitionFit: Shredded cabbage dressed with mayonnaise is a classic cold side salad.

parts.note: a chill is coldness
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cold person is somehow hot property.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface contrast of cold and hot hides the pepper.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot red pepper used to make food fiery is spicy fare.

clue.text: None in the fifties went before rested

indicators.note: in places the first piece inside the second

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty, so two of them give LL
O, a nought, means none
led means went in front

explanation.surface: Nobody in the 1950s led the way before taking a rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O (nought, none) inside LL, two Roman fifties.
explanation.definitionFit: To loll is to lounge or relax lazily.

clue.text: A few words written when there's time

definitions.meaning: a written grammatical unit of words
a prison term, as in doing time

explanation.definitionFit: A grammatical unit of written words; also the term a judge hands down to a convict.

clue.text: Keen on opposing cut in benefit

indicators.note: cutting in means the letter is inserted into the other word

parts.note: aid is help or benefit
V, short for versus, means against or opposing

explanation.surface: Someone eager to fight a reduction in welfare payments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut in' puts V (versus) inside AID.
explanation.definitionFit: Avid means eager or enthusiastic.

indicators.note: moving uneasily suggests the letters of the word before are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A restless child who can't sit still may nonetheless be very bright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uneasily' rearranges the letters of FIDGET; 'though' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A gifted child is one with exceptional talent or brains.

definitions.meaning: resolved or firmly set on something
camping means staying under canvas, in a tent

explanation.definitionFit: Being intent is being resolved; split in two it also describes someone camping under canvas.

parts.note: not lively pubs but horizontal bars hung on ropes that swing, used by acrobats

explanation.definitionFit: Circus acrobats perform on horizontal rods hung from two ropes.

parts.note: to do something such as the flowers is to arrange it
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Organising the public's whip-round.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift to charity is a contribution.

clue.text: The Roman flooring is in a state!

parts.note: the Roman, i.e. the Italian, word for 'the' is il
lino, short for linoleum, is a floor covering
taken as written

explanation.surface: An Italian floor covering is found somewhere in a US state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Roman' asks for 'the' in Italian, IL, not Roman numerals.
explanation.definitionFit: The Midwestern territory with Chicago as its largest city is one of the fifty US states.

definitions.meaning: to pull something taut, putting tension on it
a line of descent or breed, as of plants or animals

explanation.definitionFit: To stretch a muscle is to put tension on it; a particular breed or variety is a line or stock.

definitions.meaning: a hospital attendant who helps staff

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means neat and methodical; as a noun a hospital attendant or a soldier serving an officer.

parts.note: to misrepresent the truth is to have lied

indicators.note: soldiers in retreat go backwards, so their letters are read from the end

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A news report falsely described troops in retreat, and songs are made of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreating' turns RE (Royal Engineers) round to ER after LIED. 'Such songs' points to the German word for songs as used for art songs.
explanation.definitionFit: German art songs for voice and piano, by Schubert and others, are known by the German plural for songs.

clue.text: The church might well have this set aside

definitions.text: The church might well have this set aside

parts.words: The church might well have this set aside
parts.note: a cruciform church has an arm set crosswise, a part placed to the side of the nave

explanation.definitionFit: The cross arms of a cruciform church run at right angles across the nave, like spaces set to one side.

clue.text: Its operators expect to net a profit in the main

definitions.text: Its operators expect to net a profit in the main

parts.words: Its operators expect to net a profit in the main
parts.note: 'net' means catching fish in a net and 'the main' is the sea, not mostly

explanation.definitionFit: A fishing boat dragging a large net through the sea earns its crew their living.

clue.text: A way to encompass exceptionally clear colour

indicators.note: the first piece is placed around the second so that it encircles it

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: exceptionally suggests the letters of the next word appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A road built around something unusually clear, described by its shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exceptionally' rearranges CLEAR to CARLE, which ST 'encompasses'.
explanation.definitionFit: A brilliant red hue, the shade of a cardinal's robes.

clue.text: Left one to go over certain material

indicators.note: going over means turning back, so the following word is written backwards

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned leaves just one person to review a certain fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go over' turns ONE round to ENO, after L for left.
explanation.definitionFit: A leno is a light open-weave fabric, a kind of cloth.

indicators.note: off means not right, so the letters of the words before are disordered

explanation.surface: Members of Parliament fail to score in a crush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges MPSSCORE.
explanation.definitionFit: To compress is to squeeze or crowd things together.

clue.text: Always in smart surroundings, being a director

indicators.note: in places the first piece inside the second

parts.note: to smart is to sting; surroundings shows this word forms the outside
e'er is a poetic short form of ever, always

explanation.surface: A sharp, stylish person is forever in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' places EER (poetic e'er, ever) inside STING, which 'surroundings' marks as the outer part.
explanation.definitionFit: Steering is guiding or directing the course of something.

indicators.note: carved up suggests chopping the letters and rearranging them

explanation.surface: A rather odd question about how the joint is sliced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carved up' rearranges HOWMEATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat means to some degree, fairly or quite.

indicators.note: wrong shows the letters of the next word are set in an incorrect order

explanation.surface: Someone picks out the wrong place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' rearranges SPOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To opt is to choose or decide in favour of something.

definitions.meaning: to down a drink is to gulp it

explanation.definitionFit: A forked-tail summer migrant shares its name with the verb for gulping food or drink down the throat.

clue.text: Getting back at firm mother in the USA

indicators.note: getting back means returning, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
ma is mother

explanation.surface: Getting back at a firm mother in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting back' turns AT round to TA; the definition is a place in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacoma is a port city in Washington State, a place in the United States.
A narrow pass between hills is one sense; to make foul or corrupt is the verb sense.

clue.text: An insult is of little importance

explanation.definitionFit: A snub is one sense; as an adjective it means minor or trivial.

parts.note: P is a penny, the smallest coin
re means about or concerning
pared means trimmed or cut

explanation.surface: Coins concerning a reduction were sorted out.
explanation.walkthrough: P is a penny, Britain's smallest coin, so 'small change'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordered in the sense of arranged or put ready, as a well-ordered meal is made ready.

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the next one

parts.note: to swell is to spread or expand

explanation.surface: Something expands around England's woman novelist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts SWELL around E. Anna Sewell wrote Black Beauty.
explanation.definitionFit: Anna Sewell was the nineteenth-century English writer of the horse novel Black Beauty.

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty, a large number, so many
to ice is to chill or treat with cold

explanation.surface: Unpleasant animals that many people snub.
explanation.walkthrough: L, Roman fifty, stands for 'many'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lice are parasitic insects, widely regarded with disgust.

indicators.note: a little of the next phrase is taken, a run of letters found inside it

explanation.surface: A woman described as a bit of an angel, exceedingly good.
explanation.walkthrough: The name runs across angEL-INORdinately; 'good' completes the picture and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Elinor is a woman's name, as borne by the sensible elder Dashwood sister in Austen.

indicators.note: sound tells us to go by how the next word is spoken

parts.note: siting is the placing of something in position

explanation.surface: Positioning a speaker well for the audience to see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' signals a homophone: SITING (placement) is said like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A sighting is an act of seeing or catching view of something.

definitions.meaning: remarkable or outstanding, as in a notable success
a sign or motion made to convey a message

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means remarkable (a notable victory); as a noun it is a sign made to communicate.

indicators.note: an unsatisfactory result needs reworking, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Realising that a ten-all draw is a disappointing outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsatisfactory result' rearranges TENTENIS.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentient being is conscious, able to feel and perceive.
